facts.text: I want guidance on revising an outline so I can create a better one that will lead to a more successful draft.
I want to know what other students should start with when asking for feedback on an outline or a paper.
I want you to apply all of the requested items to my rough outline.
I want you to infer any sources I am using based on what you see in my outline.
I want a summary of the key things I need to do to improve the outline before I draft.
I will likely return here with my formal outline later to ask about improving it.
